name: Counter-Strike 1.6
description: Counter-Strike 1.6 (GoldSrc) dedicated server: HLDS, Steam app 90 plus the cstrike mod, native Linux 32-bit, anonymous login. The cstrike files are not part of a plain app_update 90, so the installer step also runs SteamCMD with app_set_config 90 mod cstrike when the cstrike folder is missing (this step is unverified and may need a few retries; use Update/verify game files to repeat it). Port 27015 carries the game (UDP) and RCON (TCP) and is mirrored. Metamod/AMX Mod X are not installed.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser (hostname convar).

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Password players need to join (sv_password). Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Remote console password (rcon_password), also needed by external admin tools. Leave empty to have one generated when the server is created (20 characters); managers can read and regenerate it in Settings.

variables.label: Starting map
variables.description: Map the server starts on (for example de_dust2, de_inferno, cs_office, as_oilrig). The map must exist on the server.

variables.label: VAC secured
variables.description: Start with Valve Anti-Cheat enabled (-secure). Disable for servers that run plugins VAC would flag.

variables.label: Ping boost
variables.description: -pingboost level 0 to 3 (Linux only). 2 is the usual value; 0 disables it.

scripts.postInstall: if [ ! -d cstrike ] || [ ! -f cstrike/liblist.gam ]; then for i in 1 2 3; do /opt/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /data/game +login anonymous +app_set_config 90 mod cstrike +app_update 90 validate +quit; [ -f cstrike/liblist.gam ] && break; done; fi; mkdir -p cstrike; touch cstrike/listip.cfg cstrike/banned.cfg; true
